name: Health Care Services Review Information
sourceRefs: Stedi (stedi.com/edi/x12-005010/segment/UM) — X12 005010 UM segment element reference, read directly from the page's own structured data. New for EDI Phase 7 (278 Health Care Services Review). UM01 (Request Category Code, e.g. "HS"=Health Services Review) + UM02 (Certification Type Code, e.g. "I"=Initial) + UM03 (Service Type Code, the same code set 270/271's own EQ01/service_type already uses) are the core review-classification fields; UM04 (composite, place-of-service info) and UM05 (composite, related-causes — accident/employment/auto) are situational.

USAGE NOTE: modeled 'situational' rather than 'required' even though Stedi's own 278-A1 page marks UM as 'M' (Mandatory) at 2000E -- this engine's usage field is GLOBAL per segment ID (no per-loop override exists; SegmentIDs is a plain []string), and UM is ALSO referenced at 2000F (Service Level), where the real spec marks it 'O' (Optional). The same shared-segment-global-usage constraint already documented on CL1.json's own correction note.
